purpose: Teach: 洗浄/貸付/清算/通商/投機/知名度/推計/税込み

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、現場の洗浄を業者に依頼しました
lines.en: We've arranged for a professional cleaning service to handle the crime scene.
lines.style: Even, official tone. Clear articulation. No rush. Each phrase lands with quiet authority and compassion balanced evenly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、被害者向け貸付制度をご案内くださりありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. Thank you for letting us know about the victim support loan program.
lines.style: Respectful, steady acknowledgment. Slight nod in the voice. Genuine gratitude—not performative. Measured pace, landing on 'thank you' with sincerity.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害金の清算手続きを支援します
lines.en: We're here to help you through the settlement process for the damages.
lines.style: Assured and methodical. Warm certainty underneath the official language. Deliberate pacing on each step of the process, inviting rather than commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察と通商当局の連携、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. I really appreciate how the police and the trade authority are working together on this.
lines.style: Genuine relief in the opening. Thoughtful pause before naming both agencies—showing he's noticed and values the coordination. Warm, not effusive.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、投機目的の不正取引を捜査しております
lines.en: We're actively investigating the fraudulent trades tied to speculation.
lines.style: Firm resolve beneath the official phrasing. Slight weight on 'actively'—showing determination. Steady rhythm, no apology in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察の知名度向上が、地域防犯につながりますね
lines.en: Yes. When the community knows the police are on top of things, it really does help prevent crime in the neighborhood.
lines.style: Thoughtful connection-making. Light emphasis on 'community knows'—he's reflecting on something he's noticed. Conversational, not rehearsed. Slight rise of insight at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪被害の推計も行っております
lines.en: We also prepare estimates of the total damage for the record.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, unhurried. Clinical precision without coldness. The 'also' carries a sense of thoroughness—checking every box, caring about completeness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。罰金は税込みで通知されるんですね
lines.en: Right. So the fine notice will show the total including tax.
lines.style: Small recognition of a detail. Conversational and direct. A tiny thread of clarity—confirming what matters. No edge, just practical understanding.
